name: Manastorm Shadowfang Keep: solo Archmage Arugal does not reset when his kit's Curse of Arugal charms the only attacker
contract: Player report: in a solo Manastorm Shadowfang Keep run, Archmage Arugal mind-controls the player and the
fight resets, so the floor cannot be completed. Arugal's SmartAI casts two charms in phase 1: the stock
Arugal's Curse (7621, event 5) and the Ascension kit's Curse of Arugal (2102679, event 9001), both with
SPELL_AURA_MOD_CHARM on effect 0. spell_manastorm_arugals_curse, which suppresses Arugal's evade while the
charm holds (#8345, #10356), was bound only to 7621, so the kit's charm still emptied his threat list and
reset him. The fix binds the same script to 2102679.
Setup follows manastorm-arugal-solo-curse-no-evade-8345: a private run of segment 49, phase match, combat
engaged, Chaotic Link present, player not pre-charmed. The case then selects Arugal and forces the kit charm
with '.cast back 2102679 triggered', so Arugal himself casts it onto the player as his event 9001 timer
would. The closing assertions confirm the player is charmed and, after Arugal's AI has had map updates to
react to the empty threat list while the charm still holds, that Arugal did not evade: Unit::
RemoveEvadeAuras() would strip his Chaotic Link encounter aura 93459. Attackability is checked only after
the 10 s charm ends, since a charmed player is always friendly to its charmer (Unit::GetReactionTo); the
player must then be able to attack Arugal again with Chaotic Link still on him.
A second report (#12046) saw Arugal heal to full health while the player was charmed. The case takes 15% of
his health before the charm; an evade reset or out-of-combat regeneration would bring him back to 100%,
while Arugal kept in combat cannot regenerate (Creature::Regenerate runs only out of combat).

steps.label: The player entered a private Manastorm instance
Match the native phase 1 Manastorm room so the boss is visible to this lane
Leaving the preparation bubble at the boss clears its safety aura
CONTROL: the player is not charmed before Curse of Arugal is cast
CONTROL: Arugal's Chaotic Link encounter aura is present before the charm
Arugal is engaged and attackable ahead of the charm (setup is otherwise correct)
Wound Arugal so a reset to full health would be visible
CONTROL: Arugal is below full health before the charm
Select Arugal so '.cast back' can resolve him as the caster
Let a little real combat happen before forcing the cast
The player is charmed by the kit's Curse of Arugal
Give Arugal's AI map updates to react to the charmed player
The charm still holds, so the checks below run while Arugal has no hostile attacker
Arugal did not evade: his Chaotic Link encounter aura survives the charm
The 10 s charm ends on its own
Arugal still did not evade once the charm is over
Arugal did not heal to full health while the player was charmed
Freed from the charm, the player can attack Arugal again and finish the fight
